display_long_description: PEARL is being developed with the support of the Foundation for Innovation in University Teaching and is being implemented in close collaboration with laboratory engineers, software developers and didactic experts. It has been carefully evaluated in several studies and has led to a significant increase in knowledge of laboratory equipment. PEARL provides a realistic and immersive experience that allows you to learn the operation and key functions of equipment such as oscilloscopes, function generators, multimeters and breadboards with various electrical components in a fun way. Immerse yourself in interactive tutorials that show you step-by-step how to use the equipment and what it can do. In addition to a comprehensive explanation of the lab equipment, you can also test your knowledge and skills interactively through various tests. With PEARL, you can easily use the lab equipment in your own and preferred environment. There's no need for expensive lab equipment or complicated setups - all you need is your Meta Quest and you're ready to go.
